Gold Prices Decline Amidst Fed Rate Hike Expectations and Easing Tensions

Gold prices have experienced a significant decline, heading towards their worst monthly drop since late 2008. This downturn is attributed to expectations of further US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes aimed at combating inflation, alongside easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Analysts suggest these factors are diminishing gold's traditional role as a safe-haven asset.
